0.0.n: Past form of できる; the stretched ending adds excitement about finishing something.

1.0.n: A stretched version of よし, an exclamation showing satisfaction or readiness to move on.

1.2.n: Used alone to announce moving on to the next thing.

2.0.n: Names the toy; the topic particle は is left out in this casual exclamation.

2.1.n: This adjective describes the enjoyment of playing with blocks; no です is needed in casual speech.

0.tip: できた can celebrate successfully making or completing something, without explicitly saying who did it.

1.tip: 次 can stand alone when context makes clear what comes next.

2.tip: Casual Japanese often drops は between a topic and an adjective describing it.
